entries.title: A pattern that names two extensions and matches neither
entries.summary: v1.108.271 fixed [#435](https://github.com/jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp/issues/435) for the `nuxt` and `nestjs` profiles by rewriting their `entry_point_patterns` as brace alternation (`{ts,js}`, `{ts,js,mjs}`). The consumer is `fnmatch`, which expands no braces: `fnmatch.translate("src/main.{ts,js}")` yields `(?s:src/main\.\{ts,js\})\Z`,

entries.title: A column recorded on the wrong exit is not a measurement
entries.summary: Reported by [@rknighton](https://github.com/rknighton), with a reproduction that runs the same query down two exits and prints the two rows side by side: the default path recorded `identity_hit=0` on an exact symbol-name match while `search_symbols_fusion` recorded `1` for the same query and the same top result.
